goal: Evaluate a risk-limited prospective policy selector using predecision autocorrelation estimates, comparing errors, abstentions, observations and frozen loss with SG032 and fixed240.
rule: Estimate rho using detrended trimmed t0..109; choose SG030 conservative adaptive only when rho_est <0.60; otherwise choose fixed240. Compare SG032's rho_est<0.82 rule and always-fixed240. No continuation leakage.
